entries.topic: Global layer after 1948: aid to Africa for UN votes, ELNET, the Israel Allies Foundation, the state campaigns (Kela Shlomo, Concert, Voices of Israel), US vetoes, the 1982 move against Israel's UN status, Resolution 3379 and its 1975 votes (Nov 2026)
claims: From the late 1950s Israel sent aid to newly independent African states. Ben-Gurion: "Our aid to the new countries... is not a matter of philanthropy."
Israel had one UN vote against 18 Arab members, so "it was important for Israel to try to win as many African votes as possible."
After the October 1973 war "all of Israel's friends on the continent" cut ties; Ethiopia did so formally on 23 Oct 1973.
23 Oct 1973: Ethiopia formally broke relations with Israel.

Registered 22 Oct 2007; in Belgium, France, Germany, Poland, the UK, Italy and Israel; describes itself as "the most influential pro-Israel advocacy organisation in Europe"; takes European lawmakers and officials to Israel.
Declassified UK (2024): pro-Israel lobbyists including ELNET donated to 13 of the 25 members of Labour's cabinet; The Intercept (2025): US donors fund its American arm, FELNET.
Builds pro-Israel caucuses of lawmakers in parliaments abroad; it launched six new caucuses in Africa.

2018: 128 million shekels approved for Kela Shlomo (it raised about a fifth of the matching funds); 2022: 25 million shekels a year as "Concert"; later "Voices of Israel", whose contract the Diaspora Ministry ended in 2024. Its director general: "this activity has failed by every conceivable parameter."
By 2023 the US had vetoed Israel-related Security Council resolutions 46 times, and cast 34 of the 36 vetoes on Israel-Palestine drafts since 1945 (Al Jazeera count).
Expelling or suspending a UN member needs a Security Council recommendation, where the US holds a veto.
April 1982: Syria moved that the General Assembly "review Israel's status in the United Nations", opening a later vote on suspension or expulsion; diplomats saw no majority for expulsion.
Feb 1982: the State Department warned that suspending or expelling Israel "would have serious consequences for continued U.S. participation in and support for the United Nations."
10 Nov 1975: "Zionism is a form of racism" adopted 72 to 35 with 32 abstaining.
16 Dec 1991: Resolution 46/86 revoked 3379, 111 to 25 with 13 abstaining.
